name: Speaker Calibrator (PipeWire)
author: Michael de By (Omaxian port)
description: Measure with one or many microphones and generate adaptive, repeat-validated, protected parametric speaker tuning (PipeWire filter-chain only).

barWidget.description: PipeWire only. Calibrate speakers with a filter-chain; use the PulseAudio plugin on PulseAudio hosts.
